title: L3-AV rubric — audio and video judged like a person

artifactBinding.rule: A verdict may only certify the artifact whose sha256 prefix it carries; a changed artifact re-opens the review.

levels.human-verified: A human attested the review (humanAttestation is mandatory).
levels.agent-proxy: An agent persona reviewed it — never presented as a human review.
levels.machine-only: Only machine facts exist; no person (or persona) reviewed the output.

audio.title: Audible
audio.passCriterion: The exported track carries a real signal: decoded peak >= 0.01 and silence ratio <= 0.9, and the reviewer hears sound in every judged clip.
audio.humanJudgement: Does anything actually come out of the speakers?

audio.title: No clipping
audio.passCriterion: Clipped sample ratio <= 0.01 and no audible distortion in the judged clips.
audio.humanJudgement: Does the sound distort or crackle?

audio.title: Correct voice and language
audio.passCriterion: The spoken voice is the intended language and voice (Tamil, Indian male preferred), or the absence of speech is explicitly stated as a known limit.
audio.humanJudgement: Is the voice the right language and persona?

audio.title: Intelligible and matches the script
audio.passCriterion: Every judged segment is intelligible and its spoken words match the EDL script for that scene.
audio.humanJudgement: Can you understand it, and does it say what the script says?

audio.title: No dead air
audio.passCriterion: No unexplained silence longer than 2s outside the scripted pauses; gaps are listed as follow-ups.

audio.title: In sync with picture
audio.passCriterion: The narration for scene N starts within +/- 1.5s of scene N's picture start, and the A/V drift stays within one frame of the container duration.
audio.humanJudgement: Does the voice land with the right scene?

video.title: Rendered
video.passCriterion: Frames are non-black and non-placeholder; the scene content is visible.
video.humanJudgement: Is there actual picture, or a placeholder?

video.title: Legible
video.passCriterion: Overlays and subtitles are readable at 1280px with no clipping or overlap.
video.humanJudgement: Can you read the text without it running off?

video.title: Scene correspondence
video.passCriterion: The content shown in each clip matches the scene graph for that time window.
video.humanJudgement: Does the picture match the scene it claims to show?

video.title: Continuity
video.passCriterion: Neighbouring clips show a coherent progression; no act is skipped or repeated.

coverageRule.rule: At least 75% of the packaged clips must carry a verdict; the rest must be listed as follow-ups.
